printed: Oncogenes Oncogenes are usually designated by three-letter italic terms, often taken from the names of the viruses with which the genes are WHO Editorial Style Manual associated. A roman prefix may be added: “v-” for viral, “N-” for nuclear and “c-” for the gene’s cellular counterpart (proto-oncogene). Other prefixes and various suffixes are common. For example: Ha-ras-1 N-ras v-erb B yes c-abl fes/fps.
